releaseName: The agent channel ready to use
summary: One sprint since server-v0.14.0 (milestone 69). Coding agents no longer hold the owner token: draftloop-mcp init asks the server for an agent token with the owner token, saves it in the user's configuration folder and never in the project, and the server admits that token only on record_work and title-only list_work for its workspace; the owner lists and revokes agent tokens through the API, and only a hash is stored (#2147). The review link record_work returns, /#work-journal, now opens the Work journal panel (#2149); the workspace home shows how many notes wait for review (#2151); and draft-loop is on the PATH from a clone, as the self-hosted guide says (#2150).
knownLimitations: The work journal and agent tokens are served in owner-token mode only; sign-in mode waits for hosted sign-in (#2079). Agent tokens are revoked through the API, not yet from the web screen. A setup that still exports the owner token keeps working until init is run again. Staging behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
